inputs.C_delta_use: shown as a separate conditional scalar sensitivity after unadjusted single-bolt references; no actual load direction/applicability asserted
inputs.Fyb_106000_basis: commentary estimate (92 ksi specified minimum tensile yield + 120 ksi specified minimum tensile ultimate)/2 under assumed delivered SAE J429 Grade 5 conformance and ASTM F606-compatible evidence; empirical estimate, not measured or a guaranteed lower bound
inputs.Fyb_92000_basis: analyst sensitivity set equal to 92 ksi solely as a sensitivity; not a published or NDS-derived Fyb

additional_diameter_scenario.case: D=0.250-in conditional comparator, not primary Dr default
additional_diameter_scenario.not_established_by: nominal 127-mm grip or catalog Grade 5 marking alone.
additional_diameter_scenario.rule: ANSI/AWC NDS-2024 12.3.7.2 permits D in lieu of Dr only where thread bearing <=1/4 of full bearing length in the member holding threads; must be established for both members.
additional_diameter_scenario.sensitivity: Reuses the same Fyb assumptions and grain-angle matrix; applies 2024 Table 12.3.1B D>=0.25 reductions 4Ktheta, 4Ktheta, 3.6Ktheta, 3.2Ktheta, 3.2Ktheta, 3.2Ktheta.

inputs.diameter_basis: use Dr as conservative NDS threaded-fastener default while delivered thread exposure is unresolved; do not claim this is measured; D=0.250 in is allowed only if actual thread-bearing condition under NDS 12.3.7.2 is established
inputs.geometry: 88.9-mm cleat bearing thickness + 38.1-mm host bearing thickness = 127-mm grip; one wood/wood single-shear plane

unverified_product_and_receiving_conditi.Fyb_condition: The 106-ksi row is usable only as the labeled commentary estimate if the actual selected fastener is supported as SAE J429 Grade 5 and the tensile yield/ultimate basis applies. The 92-ksi row is an analyst sensitivity only. This does not create a blanket certificate gate or require a bespoke F1575 bending test.
unverified_product_and_receiving_conditi.catalog_lead: K.L. Jack 25C600HCS5Z, 1/4-20 x 6-in Grade 5 zinc-plated hex cap screw, listed to SAE J429 and ASME B18.2.1; candidate only.
unverified_product_and_receiving_conditi.diameter_condition: Dr=0.189 in is the conditional standard-based UNC root input; receiving identity/thread standard or actual root measurement remains unverified. The D=0.250-in comparator requires the delivered thread exposure in each member to satisfy NDS 12.3.7.2; nominal 127-mm grip by itself does not establish that condition.
unverified_product_and_receiving_conditi.not_claimed: No delivered bolt, SKU/lot trace, manufacturer certificate, lot test report, actual tensile values, or measured thread-root diameter is represented by this diagnostic.
unverified_product_and_receiving_conditi.receiving_scope: Verify the actual delivered part identity, applicable standard/grade and dimensions/thread transition for the hardware used. No generic external approval or destructive test is prescribed here.

inputs.wood: DF-L No.2 group G=0.50; solid wood bearing inputs
